findings.description: `total = sum(1 for _ in lines)` exhausts `lines`. The CLI passes an open file object, which is a one-shot iterator. The later `for line in lines` loop then sees no lines. The run reads 0 lines and writes an empty output file, and progress reports 0/N.
findings.suggestion: Do not pre-count a generic iterable. Pass the total separately, or materialize with `lines = list(lines)` (costly for large files). Alternatively, report progress without a total.
findings.title: Counting lines consumes a one-shot iterator, so nothing is processed

findings.description: In the `except LookupTimeout` branch, `return enrich(event, geo)` lacks `await`. `enrich` is now async, so `enrich_one` returns a coroutine object. The sink then receives a coroutine instead of an Event, and `to_json` fails or the coroutine is never run. The retry never actually happens. A second timeout cannot abort the run as documented. It also runs outside the try block and semantics are lost.
findings.suggestion: Use `return await enrich(event, geo)` in the retry branch.
findings.title: Retry returns an un-awaited coroutine instead of an Event
